V4 native-currency pools are routable (Hub.addV4 admits them as KIND_V4_NATIVE, src/BlazePhoenixHub.sol:935-990; _scanV4 probes address(0), :1271-1314; the Router executes kind 8, src/BlazePhoenixRouter.sol:1007,2083). every distinct pair of the selected pools of the chain (token order: lowercase address, a < b)
W = 25 % of the sum of tvl_usd of the pair's selected pools measured by balances; a pair with only V4 selected pools uses the in-range virtual value (an upper bound, whale_basis says so)
dust, k-2..k7 (size in USD in [10^k, 10^(k+1))), whale; a bucket whose floor 10^k >= W is out

seed = sha256(utf8('gas-1114|' + chain + '|' + token_a + '|' + token_b + '|' + bucket + '|' + str(i))) hex, i < N; f = low 64 bits / 2^64; fixed by this rule before any measurement, never chosen from data
k bucket: size_usd = 10^(k + f); whale: size_usd = W * 2^(-f) (in [W/2, W]); amount_in = max(1, floor(size_usd / price_in * 10^decimals_in)); dust: amount_in = 1 + (seed mod 1000) wei, no USD size
price_in = the universe token price at the fork block (stable = 1 USD, every other token the mid of its deepest priced pool); a pair with an unpriced token measures only dust
i even: token_a -> token_b; i odd: token_b -> token_a (every prefix N' >= 2 holds both directions)

if the budget cannot hold the grid, run the prefix i < N' with N' in {8, 4, 2, 1}, the same N' for every cell and chain, chosen by budget only before any result is read, and recorded in results.tsv; runs go i-major (every cell at i = 0, then i = 1, ...) so a cut run is a whole prefix
Quoter quote at the fork block -> pv.route; then Router.swapExactIn(pv.route) (src/BlazePhoenixRouter.sol:454): the route passed by the caller

Router.swapBestExactIn (src/BlazePhoenixRouter.sol:568): the Solver routes on-chain; state in {D, M0, M1h, M6h, M24h, M72h, MF24h, MF72h} as in tools/g7-gas-campaign/g7.py:8-16 and spec.json (ages M0 0, M1h 3600, M6h 21600, M24h 86400, M72h 259200 s; mf_ages M24h, M72h; DISCOVERY_TTL_SECONDS 3600, src/BlazePhoenixSolver.sol:122)
Router.swapExactInNative (src/BlazePhoenixRouter.sol:529) with msg.value, on the draws whose token_in is the wrapped native; out for pairs without it
a 2-leg route token_in -> bridge -> token_out passed to swapExactIn; bridge = the first A token of the chain (universe order) outside the pair with a routable universe pool on both hops; out if none
every routable universe pool of the pair quoted alone at the fork block; the best one executed as a 1-leg swapExactIn; gives out_best_single, best_single_pool and gas
cold and warm for every mode: warm = with the access list of eth_createAccessList (EIP-2929), cold = without (G7 method)
modes are compared only paired by draw (same cell, i, amount_in and fork block)
i = 0 of each cell is also quoted on the market sources (market.tsv)

B resamples of the draw indices within a stratum, percentile 95 % interval, statistic = median (and the median paired difference between modes); resampling seed = sha256(utf8('gas-1114-boot|' + stratum_id))
rates (revert, noroute, noquote) with the Wilson 95 % interval
